name: aicommits
setup: . scripts/env.sh && cd "$SRC" && rm -rf node_modules dist && npm_config_store_dir="$RM/.tools/pnpm-store" npm_config_cache_dir="$RM/.tools/pnpm-cache" npm_config_state_dir="$RM/.tools/pnpm-state" npm_config_manage_package_manager_versions=false "$RM/.tools/pm/node_modules/.bin/pnpm" install --frozen-lockfile
test_cmd: unset OPENAI_BASE_URL; export OPENAI_API_KEY=; npm_config_store_dir="$RM/.tools/pnpm-store" npm_config_cache_dir="$RM/.tools/pnpm-cache" npm_config_state_dir="$RM/.tools/pnpm-state" npm_config_manage_package_manager_versions=false "$RM/.tools/pm/node_modules/.bin/pnpm" build && npm_config_store_dir="$RM/.tools/pnpm-store" npm_config_cache_dir="$RM/.tools/pnpm-cache" npm_config_state_dir="$RM/.tools/pnpm-state" npm_config_manage_package_manager_versions=false "$RM/.tools/pm/node_modules/.bin/pnpm" test
notes: Env: commands assume $RM (router-migrate root) and $SRC (working copy) are exported and scripts/env.sh is sourced (setup does this itself); run every step under `env -u RAMP_ROUTER_API_KEY`. Node v24.19.0, npm 11.17.0, local pnpm 10.34.7, yarn berry from the repo. test_cmd = `pnpm build && pnpm test` (pkgroll bundle to dist/, then `tsx tests`, manten). dist/ is gitignored. Without $RM the equivalent is `./node_modules/.bin/pkgroll --minify --clean-dist && ./node_modules/.bin/tsx tests`. OPENAI_API_KEY is forced to empty (both in test_cmd and test_env) and OPENAI_BASE_URL is unset, so the live specs self-skip and nothing hits the network. Offline LLM coverage comes from MockLanguageModelV4 DI, a local 127.0.0.1 OpenAI-compatible fake server (headless specs) and fetch monkeypatches. Baseline: 79 passed, 0 failed. Skips: manten does not report skipped tests. "skipped": 14 is a STATIC count of the test() calls in tests/specs/cli/commits.ts, a suite that returns before registering when OPENAI_API_KEY is empty. In addition, git-hook.ts "Commits" returns early and is counted among the 79 passed (vacuous pass). The tests set HOME to fixture dirs, so ~/.aicommits is untouched. CI uses pnpm v9 and the local pnpm 10.34.7 works (lockfile v9; no packageManager pin). The repo also contains a stray package-lock.json, which is ignored (pnpm-lock.yaml is used). typecheck_cmd = repo `type-check` script (tsc, noEmit in tsconfig, 50 project files, TS 5.9.3): 0 errors. .nvmrc says v22.14.0 but Node 24 works. Cold-cache install took 9s. Each of the 2 runs: 79 passed (6.5s, 5.7s), no flakiness.
